_doc: Known, reasoned exceptions for scripts/contract (npm run test:contract). Every entry needs a reason; remove it once the backend spec is fixed.

missingInBackend.POST /v1/auth/organizations: Self-service business creation (mobile onboarding, feat/onboarding). Backend endpoint is being implemented in parallel in otopoly-go: bearer, no organization context, body {organization_name (2-120), phone?, city?, district?, address?} → 201 {organization: {uuid, slug, name}}; 400 VALIDATION_ERROR, 401, 403 (self-registration disabled), 409 CONFLICT (already owns a business), 429 RATE_LIMITED. Remove once it is in openapi.yaml.

specFixes.reason: Spec bug: GET /v1/app/config is documented as EnvelopeStatus (data.status required), but the Go handler (httpserver.handleAppConfig) answers {mode, name, registration_enabled, auth_methods, letterhead, ...} without `status`. The response schema is skipped until the spec documents the real payload.
